help.intro: A quick picture of how the pieces you can use actually fit together. This page only shows what your account can do — someone else's Help page may look different.

getting_started.title: Getting Started
getting_started.blurb: Every visit starts the same way.
steps: Log in with the email and password staff gave you — nobody signs themselves up.
The sidebar on the left only lists what your account is allowed to do.
The bell icon shows things that happened for you (an absence, a payment, a complaint update).
The sun/moon icon and your name (top-right) hold theme and profile settings — every account can upload its own photo there.

enrolling.title: Enrolling & Moving Students
enrolling.blurb: One student can travel through the system three ways.
steps: People → Students → Enroll Student — pick a section, link a parent (new, existing, or later).
People → Promote Students moves a WHOLE class into next year's section at once, or graduates the final grade.
A single student needing a different section right now (not the whole class) uses the "Section" box on their own Edit page instead.

money.title: How Money Works
money.blurb: No payment gateway — every payment is confirmed by a person.
steps: Finance → Fee Structures / Optional Services sets prices and how often they're charged.
Finance → Invoices → Generate Invoices builds the right number of invoices per student automatically.
A parent sees exactly where to send money (set in Settings → School Profile) right on their invoice.
Finance → Payment Verification is where a submitted payment gets approved or rejected — this is the only place money actually changes an invoice's status.

attendance_flow.title: Taking Attendance
attendance_flow.blurb: One class, one date, one save.
steps: Attendance → Take Attendance. A teacher only ever sees their own class here.
A student marked Absent automatically notifies their parent — nothing extra to do.
Export to Excel prints a blank roster for a teacher without a device — tick it on paper, enter it later.

marks_flow.title: Marks Workflow
marks_flow.blurb: Only "Published" ever reaches a report card.
steps: Academics → Enter Marks (teacher) → Result Approvals (approver) → Publish.
Sending a batch back with a note is normal — nothing is visible to parents until it's Published.
Report cards are always calculated live from published marks — nobody types an average in by hand.

complaints_staff.title: Handling Complaints
complaints_staff.blurb: Every complaint shows who sent it and which child it's about.
steps: Complaints shows the child's current grade/section automatically, plus any siblings also enrolled — you never have to look that up separately.
Change its status (Open / In Progress / Resolved) and add a note — the family sees that note and gets notified.

complaints_family.title: Submitting a Complaint
complaints_family.blurb: Tell the school something, and know when it's handled.
steps: Complaints → New Complaint. If you have more than one child, you pick which one it's about (or leave it general).
Track it any time under Complaints — My Complaints shows only your own.

paying_invoice.title: Paying an Invoice
paying_invoice.blurb: Pay outside the app, then prove it.
steps: Open your child's invoice — the school's account details are shown right there.
Submit the amount, method, a reference number, and a photo of the receipt.
You're notified the moment it's verified — or rejected, with the reason.

auditor.title: What You Can See
auditor.body: Wherever a list or an export button exists for a specific job (Students, Invoices, Attendance, Payments...), you see it too automatically — without needing that job's permission yourself. What you will never see is an "Add," "Edit," or "Delete" button. If you're trying to change something and can't find the button, that's not a bug — Auditor accounts genuinely cannot change anything, anywhere.

parent.att_rate: {{rate}}% of school days present or late this year
parent.fees_none: No bill has been made for this school year yet.
parent.fees_waiting_title_one: 1 payment is waiting for the school
parent.fees_waiting_title_other: {{count}} payments are waiting for the school
parent.fees_waiting_body: {{amount}} ETB sent. Waiting for the school.
parent.bill_pay_one: See the bill and how to pay
parent.fees_all_paid_note: All bills for this school year are paid.
parent.report_body: See {{name}}'s results, or keep a copy as a PDF.
parent.att_rate_note_one: Present and late days, out of {{count}} recorded day.
parent.att_rate_note_other: Present and late days, out of {{count}} recorded days.
parent.att_none_body: When the teacher marks your child's attendance it will appear here.
parent.att_correction_note: The school can correct a day after it is first recorded. You will get a message if an absence is changed.
parent.report_page_desc: Choose a child to see the report card.
parent.rc_not_ready: Some results are still being finalised by the school, so this report card may change.
parent.msg_none_hint: Messages from the school will appear here.
parent.pay_ask_school: Please ask the school office how to pay.
parent.bill_waived: The school has waived the rest
parent.pay_intro: Choose how you paid below, and we'll show you exactly where to send it.
parent.pay_step1: Pay the money to one of these accounts.
parent.pay_step2: Take a clear photo of the receipt.
parent.payments_none: You have not sent a payment for this bill yet.
parent.pay_pending_note: The school is checking it. You will get a message.
parent.pay_rejected_next: You can send a new photo below.
parent.pay_at_school: You can also pay at the school office. Bring the money or your slip: the staff will record it and give you a receipt. You do not need to use this website.

perm.manage-branches_hint: Add or change the school's branches.
perm.manage-school-settings_hint: Name, contact details, calendar, languages, payment accounts and school rules.
perm.manage-grading-scale_hint: Choose what marks mean (A, B, C and so on).
perm.manage-staff_hint: Add staff, change job titles and permissions, and switch accounts on or off.
perm.manage-students_hint: Enrol students and change their records.
perm.manage-parents_hint: Add or change parent and guardian records.
perm.manage-teachers_hint: Choose which teacher teaches which subject in which class.
perm.manage-classes_hint: Create grades and sections and choose each section's homeroom teacher.
perm.override-section-capacity_hint: Enrol or promote a student into a full section, with a written reason.
perm.mark-attendance_hint: Mark who is present, absent, late, excused or sick.
perm.view-attendance-reports_hint: Look at attendance summaries for classes and students.
perm.enter-marks_hint: Type in students' marks for the subjects they teach.
perm.approve-results_hint: Check mark sheets sent in by teachers and approve them or send them back.
perm.publish-results_hint: Make approved results and report cards visible to parents.
perm.manage-assignments_hint: Reserved for class and subject assignments. It does not open a screen by itself today.
perm.manage-fee-structures_hint: Add or change the fees for each grade and school year.
perm.manage-invoices_hint: Create bills for students, and give discounts within the school's limit.
perm.verify-payments_hint: Look at payment proofs and accept them or send them back with a reason.
perm.view-financial-reports_hint: Look at totals for fees, payments and what is still owed.
perm.refund-payments_hint: Give money back, or undo a payment that was already accepted.
perm.approve-large-discounts_hint: Give discounts or waivers above the limits the school has set.
perm.manage-announcements_hint: Write announcements that parents and staff can read.
perm.manage-complaints_hint: Read complaints from parents and reply to them.
perm.view-audit-log_hint: Read the record of who changed what, and when.
perm.inventory-view_hint: Look at the item catalog, stores, and stock levels.
perm.inventory-manage: Manage the item catalog and stores
perm.inventory-manage_hint: Add or change items, categories, and stores.
perm.stock-receive_hint: Record stock coming in, e.g. from a purchase.
perm.stock-issue_hint: Hand out stock from a store, with a reason.
perm.stock-transfer_hint: Move stock from one store to another.
perm.stock-adjust_hint: Correct a stock count after a physical count, with a reason.
perm.requisition-create_hint: Ask for stock to be drawn from a store, for approval.
perm.requisition-approve_hint: Review requisitions and approve or reject them, in full or in part.
perm.requisition-issue_hint: Hand out stock against an approved requisition, in full or in part.
perm.asset-view_hint: Look at the asset register and its history.
perm.asset-manage_hint: Add assets, assign or transfer them, and record repairs, loss or disposal.
perm.purchase-request-create_hint: Ask for something to be bought, for approval.
perm.purchase-approve_hint: Review purchase requests up to the school's usual limit and approve or reject them.
perm.purchase-approve-large_hint: Approve purchase requests above the school's configured amount.
perm.quotation-manage_hint: Record a supplier's quoted prices against an approved purchase request, compare them, and choose one.
perm.purchase-order-manage_hint: Turn an approved purchase request into a formal order for a supplier, send it, or cancel it.
perm.goods-receipt-manage_hint: Record what actually arrived from a supplier against a sent purchase order, adding it to store stock.
perm.accounting-view: View the chart of accounts and financial ledgers
perm.accounting-view_hint: See the chart of accounts, journal entries, the ledger and financial reports without being able to change them.
perm.accounting-manage: Manage the chart of accounts and post journal entries
perm.accounting-manage_hint: Create and edit accounts and journals, and create, edit, post or reverse journal entries.
perm.accounting-period-manage_hint: Start a new accounting period and close a finished one so its books stop changing.
perm.accounting-period-reopen_hint: A stronger, rarer permission than closing -- undoes a closed period so it can be posted into again.
perm.supplier-bill-manage_hint: Record what a supplier billed the school for, turning it into an expense owed to them.
perm.supplier-payment-manage_hint: Record money paid to a supplier against a bill they sent.
perm.employee-view_hint: See employee profiles, departments and job titles without being able to change them.
perm.employee-manage_hint: Add and edit employee profiles, departments and job titles, and link/unlink a login account.
perm.contract-view_hint: See contract details and documents without being able to change them.
perm.contract-manage_hint: Add, change and renew employment contracts, and upload their documents.
perm.staff-attendance-view_hint: See the daily attendance roster and history without being able to change it.
perm.staff-attendance-manage_hint: Record daily attendance, request corrections, and approve or reject corrections someone else requested.
perm.leave-view_hint: See leave types, balances and requests without being able to change them.
perm.leave-request_hint: Submit a leave request for yourself (if you have a linked employee record).
perm.leave-approve_hint: Manage leave types and allocations, submit leave on behalf of anyone in scope, and approve or reject requests someone else submitted.
perm.performance-view_hint: See review cycles and performance reviews without being able to change them.
perm.performance-manage_hint: Set up review cycles, write performance reviews for employees in scope, and finalize them. You can never write or finalize your own review.
perm.payroll-view_hint: See payroll settings, runs and payslips without being able to change them.
perm.payroll-manage: Manage payroll settings and run payroll
perm.payroll-manage_hint: Edit pension rates and tax brackets, generate and finalize monthly payroll runs.
perm.timetable-view_hint: See periods, rooms and the timetable without being able to change them.
perm.timetable-manage: Manage periods, rooms and the timetable
perm.timetable-manage_hint: Set up the bell schedule and rooms, and build the weekly timetable for every class.
perm.timetable-override_hint: Save a timetable slot even though it conflicts with another -- always with a typed reason, always audited.
perm.manage-calendar_hint: Add, change and remove calendar events, and choose who sees them.
perm.medical-records-view_hint: See a student's allergies, conditions and medications without being able to change them.
perm.medical-records-manage_hint: Add and update a student's allergies, conditions, medications and physician details.
perm.library-view_hint: See the book catalog and who has what on loan, without being able to change anything.
perm.library-manage_hint: Add books and copies, issue, return, renew, and record lost/damaged copies and fines.
perm.discipline-view_hint: See a student's incident history without being able to change it.
perm.discipline-manage_hint: Record incidents, decide actions, and resolve cases.

staff.page_desc: The people who work at the school: their job title (only a label) and their system role (what they can open and do).
staff.search: Search name, phone, job title or role…
staff.empty_body: Add your first staff member. You will be asked a few short questions.
staff.role_change_hint: Changing this resets what they can do to that role's usual list (you can still customize a branch admin's below).
staff.role_change_warning: {{role}}'s usual permissions will replace what this person can do now, as soon as you save.
staff.cannot_change_own_role: You cannot change your own system role. Ask another owner or administrator.
staff.inactive_title: This person will not be able to sign in
staff.inactive_body: Their records and history stay. You can switch the account on again at any time.
staff.desc_add: Three short steps: the person, what they may use in the school, then their sign-in account.
staff.step_who_desc: Their name, phone number and job title.
staff.step_access_desc: Their role, branch and permissions. This is separate from their job title.
staff.step_review_desc: Read everything once more. You can change any answer.
staff.why_who: Type their name and an Ethiopian mobile number to continue.
staff.why_branch: Choose the branch this person works at.
staff.why_perms: Tick at least one permission, or this person will not be able to do anything.
staff.name: Full name
staff.name_hint: As they would like to be called, for example Almaz Bekele.
staff.title_hint: For example Vice Principal or Registrar. It is only a label shown next to their name. It gives no access.
staff.phone_hint: They sign in with this. For example 0911 22 33 44.
staff.email_hint: Optional contact only. Not needed to sign in.
staff.err_email: This does not look like an email address. Check it has an @ and a dot.
staff.vs_title_body: Only a name for their job, such as Registrar. It changes nothing about what they can do.
staff.vs_access_body: What they can really open and do in the system. Only these decide access.
staff.vs_access_body_short: What they can really open and do. Only this decides access.
staff.role_owner_hint: Full access to every branch and every setting.
staff.role_branch_admin_hint: Runs one branch. You choose exactly what they may do, for example Registrar or Vice Principal.
staff.role_teacher_hint: Takes attendance and enters marks for their own classes.
staff.role_accountant_hint: Handles fees, bills and checking payments.
staff.role_auditor_hint: Can only look, never change: reports and the audit log, across all branches.
staff.owner_warn_body: This includes adding and removing other staff and changing money records. Only choose this for someone who runs the whole school.
staff.all_branches_note: This role works across every branch, so no single branch is chosen.
staff.branch_label: Which branch do they work at?
staff.fixed_branch: They will work at your branch: {{branch}}.
staff.perm_head: What may this branch admin do?
staff.perm_intro: The usual set is already ticked. Untick what they should not do, tick what they should.
staff.perm_cannot_give: You cannot give this one because you do not have it yourself.
staff.perm_summary_none: Nothing: this person would not be able to do anything.
staff.cannot_title: Some of this person's permissions are hidden from you
staff.cannot_body_one: 1 of their permissions is one you do not hold yourself, so it is not shown. Saving here will take it away. Ask someone who holds it if it must stay.
staff.cannot_body_other: {{count}} of their permissions are ones you do not hold yourself, so they are not shown. Saving here will take them away. Ask someone who holds them if they must stay.
staff.fixed_intro: This is the same for every person with this role. It cannot be changed one by one.
staff.r_can_do: What they will be able to do
staff.review_note: When you add them, you see a temporary password once, to give them. They sign in with their phone number and this password, then choose their own. You never see their own password.
staff.save_button: Add staff member and create password
staff.saved_line: The account is ready. Now give them their sign-in details.
staff.saved_next: Send this link to them (in person, WhatsApp or SMS). They open it and choose their own password.
staff.saved_emailed: We also emailed this link to them.
staff.saved_not_emailed: Email is not set up here, so please send the link yourself.
staff.saved_once: It works once and stops working on {{date}}. You will not see it again, but you can make a new one from the staff list.
staff.err_phone: This does not look like an Ethiopian mobile number. It should start with 09, 07 or +251.
staff.phone_change_hint: They sign in with this number. Changing it changes how they sign in.
staff.phone_add_hint: Add a mobile number so they can sign in with it.
staff.no_phone: No phone number yet (signs in with email)
staff.reset_title: Make a new temporary password for {{name}}?
staff.reset_body: {{name}}'s current password stops working at once, and they are signed out everywhere.
staff.reset_body2: You will see the new temporary password once, to give to them. They must choose their own at the next sign-in.
staff.unlock_title: Let {{name}} try to sign in again?
staff.unlock_body: Their waiting time and failed tries are cleared. Their password is not changed, and this is written to the security log.
staff.why_password: The password needs at least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
staff.err_password: Use at least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
staff.pw_generate_hint: A safe, easy-to-read password is made and shown once after you create the account.
staff.pw_own_hint: Type a temporary password yourself. The person must still change it when they first sign in.
staff.pw_hint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
staff.class_hint: Optional. Only classes that do not have a homeroom teacher yet. You can leave this empty and set it later.
staff.class_none: There is no class without a homeroom teacher in this branch.
staff.give_body: You will see the phone number and a temporary password once. Give them to the person yourself. They must choose their own password when they first sign in.
staff.disable_body1: {{name}} is signed out at once and cannot sign in again until you switch the account back on.
staff.disable_body2: Nothing is deleted. Their attendance, marks, payments and history stay exactly as they were.
staff.enable_body: They can sign in again with their existing password. If they forgot it, use Reset password afterwards.
staff.enable_reset_title: Switch {{name}}'s account on with a new password?
staff.enable_reset_body: The account is switched on, and a new temporary password is made for it. The old password stops working, and they must choose a new one at their next sign-in.
staff.enable_reset_confirm: Switch {{name}}'s account on with a new password

sect.desc_add: Three short steps: where it belongs, its name and size, then a check.
sect.step_where_desc: Choose the grade, the branch and the school year.
sect.why_where: Choose a grade, a branch and a school year to continue.
sect.step_details_desc: What is the section called, and how many students fit?
sect.why_details: Type a name that is not already used, and leave capacity empty or use a number.
sect.step_review_desc: Read it once more. You can change any answer.
sect.no_grades_body: Add a grade first, from the Grades and sections page.
sect.existing_none: None yet. This will be the first.
sect.name_hint: Usually a letter, for example A or B, so the class reads {{grade}} A.
sect.err_dup: There is already a section {{name}} here. Choose a different name.
sect.capacity_hint: You can leave this empty. Then the section has no limit. If you set a number, nobody can be added beyond it without a written reason.
sect.err_capacity: Type a whole number of 1 or more, or leave it empty.
sect.review_note: After you create it, you can enrol students into it and choose its homeroom teacher.
sect.saved_note: Next you can choose a homeroom teacher and the teachers for each subject.
sect.add_other_grade: Add a section to a different grade

struct.page_desc: Grades (such as Grade 5) and their sections (such as Grade 5 B): who is in each, how full it is, and who its homeroom teacher is.
struct.empty_body: Start by adding a grade, for example Grade 1 or KG1. Then add its sections.
struct.no_sections: No sections yet. Add the first one so students can be enrolled.
struct.grade_order_hint: A small number shows first. For example 1 for Grade 1, 2 for Grade 2.
struct.section_edit_locked: {{branch}} · {{year}}. The branch and the school year cannot be changed.
struct.capacity_edit_hint_one: 1 student is in this section now, so the limit cannot be lower than 1. Leave empty for no limit.
struct.capacity_edit_hint_other: {{count}} students are in this section now, so the limit cannot be lower than {{count}}. Leave empty for no limit.
struct.remove_grade_body: A grade that has sections, fees or students cannot be removed. If this one has any, nothing is removed and you will be told why.
struct.remove_section_body: A section that has students, mark sheets, report cards or teachers cannot be removed. If this one has any, nothing is removed and you will be told why.

teach.page_desc: Start with a class. Then choose its homeroom teacher and give each subject to a teacher.
teach.no_match: No class matches what you typed.
teach.no_classes_title: No classes for this school year yet
teach.no_classes_body: Add sections first, on the Grades and sections page.
teach.no_teacher_accounts: There are no teacher accounts yet
teach.no_teacher_accounts_body: Add teachers first: People, then Staff, then Add a staff member, with the role Teacher.
teach.card_no_subjects: No subjects have a teacher yet
teach.ct_desc: The teacher who looks after this class as a whole. Subject teachers are chosen separately, below.
teach.ct_readonly: You can see the homeroom teacher, but only someone who manages classes can change it.
teach.subjects_desc: Each subject has one teacher in a class.
teach.subjects_none: No subject has a teacher in this class yet. Use the box below to give the first one.
teach.remove_body: {{teacher}} will no longer be the teacher of {{subject}} in {{class}}. Marks already entered are kept.
teach.give_title: Give a subject to a teacher in {{class}}
teach.give_desc: Two questions: which subject, then which teacher.
teach.no_subjects_body: Subjects must exist before a teacher can be given one.
teach.no_teachers_title: There are no teachers in {{branch}} yet
teach.no_teachers_body: A class can only be given to a teacher who works at the same branch. Add a teacher for this branch first.
teach.already: {{teacher}} already teaches {{subject}} in this class. Nothing to change.
teach.replace_warn_title: This subject already has a teacher
teach.replace_warn_body: {{current}} teaches {{subject}} here now. Saving will move it to the teacher you chose. You will be asked to confirm.
teach.replace_title: Move {{subject}} in {{class}} to a different teacher?
teach.replace_marks: Mark sheets that are not sent in yet move with the subject. Anything already sent in, approved or published stays with the teacher who entered it.

audit.page_desc: A record of who did what, to which record, when, and why. Nothing here can be changed or deleted.
audit.f_search_hint: A name, a reason or an action…
audit.no_match_hint: Try fewer filters, or a wider range of days.
audit.none_yet_hint: Important changes in the system will appear here as they happen.
audit.action_academic_year_current_changed: The current school year was changed
audit.action_account_invitation_accepted: A person accepted their invitation and chose a password
audit.action_account_invited: An invitation to set a password was made
audit.action_invoices_batch_cancelled: A batch of bills just created was cancelled
audit.action_invoice_deleted: A bill was deleted (created by mistake)
audit.action_mark_batch_reopened: A mark sheet was opened again
audit.action_mark_batch_sent_back: A mark sheet was sent back to the teacher
audit.action_mark_batch_submitted: A mark sheet was sent in for approval
audit.action_promotion_executed: Students were promoted to the next grade
audit.action_section_capacity_overridden: A section's limit was gone over, with a reason
audit.action_staff_permissions_changed: A staff member's permissions were changed
audit.action_staff_role_assigned: A staff member was added with a role
audit.action_student_guardian_linked: A parent or guardian was linked to a student
audit.action_student_guardian_unlinked: A parent or guardian was unlinked from a student
audit.action_student_service_joined: A student joined an optional service
audit.action_student_service_price_changed: An optional service price was changed for a student
audit.action_student_service_withdrawn: A student left an optional service
audit.action_student_transferred: A student moved to another section or branch
audit.action_teaching_assignment_reassigned: A subject was moved to a different teacher
audit.action_payment_recorded: Money received at the school was recorded

settings.page_desc: Your school's details and rules, in parts. Change what you need, then save once at the bottom.
settings.details_desc: Shown on report cards and messages.
settings.calendar_desc: Which calendar do people see for dates?
settings.cal_ethiopian_hint: Dates are shown as Meskerem, Tikimt and so on.
settings.cal_gregorian_hint: Dates are shown as September, October and so on.
settings.cal_both_hint: Each date is shown in both.
settings.reports_desc: What should happen when a published exam has no score for a student, for example because they were absent?
settings.reports_warn: Choose this before you publish results. It changes every student's average and class rank.
settings.money_desc: Staff who manage bills can give discounts and waivers up to these limits on their own. Anything larger needs an owner or an administrator with approval rights. Every discount and waiver is recorded with who gave it and why.
settings.discount_limit_hint: As a percent of one bill, from 0 to 100.
settings.waiver_limit_hint: In ETB, the unpaid amount that can be waived.
settings.overlap_label: Allow terms in the same school year to overlap
settings.overlap_hint: Normally terms must not overlap. Turn this on only if your school really runs overlapping terms.
settings.languages_desc: Which languages staff and families can choose from. Each person then picks their own.
settings.lang_at_least_one: At least one language must stay on.
settings.lang_note_none: Every screen is an early, non-native translation, not yet checked by a native speaker. See Help, Localization, before relying on it.
settings.lang_note_some: {{settled}} of {{total}} screens are established or native-checked; the other {{rest}} are early translations waiting for a native speaker to check them. See Help, Localization.
settings.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
settings.leave_body: You changed some settings and did not save them. If you leave now, those changes are lost.
settings.pay_desc: Shown to parents when they are about to pay a bill, so they know exactly where to send the money. Add every bank or Telebirr you accept.
settings.pay_none_body: Parents cannot see where to send money until you add one below.
settings.pay_remove_body: Parents will no longer see it when they pay. Payments already made are not affected.
settings.pay_step2: 2. Which branch is this account for?
settings.pay_branch_hint: Parents see their child's branch accounts plus any school-wide ones.
settings.pay_account_name_hint: Helps parents check they are paying the right account.
settings.purchase_threshold_hint: Purchase requests above this amount need large-purchase approval, not the ordinary one. Leave blank to skip this distinction.
settings.payment_due_days_hint: How many days after a billing period starts a family has to pay before it counts as overdue and whoever manages invoices is notified to follow up.

promo.page_desc: Move a class into the next class, or let its last-year students graduate. Four short questions, then a check.
promo.no_classes_body: Create the school year, the grades and their sections first, then come back here.
promo.step_class_desc: Choose the class the students are in now.
promo.why_no_students: This class has no students to move. Choose another class.
promo.pick_grade_first: Choose a grade first, then its classes appear.
promo.none_enrolled: Nobody is enrolled in {{class}} right now.
promo.step_who_desc: Choose for every student: moves up, graduates, or not this time.
promo.why_undecided_one: 1 student still has no choice. Choose for everyone to continue.
promo.why_undecided_other: {{count}} students still have no choice. Choose for everyone to continue.
promo.why_nobody: At least one student must move up or graduate.
promo.step_where: Which class do they go to?
promo.step_where_desc: Choose the class the students move into. You see how many places it has.
promo.why_where: Choose the class they move into.
promo.no_destination: Nobody moves up, so no class is needed. Everyone chosen graduates.
promo.where_intro: {{moves}} from {{class}} move into the class you choose.
promo.short_body: {{stay}} student(s) cannot be moved and stay where they are.
promo.short_body_override: They'll all be moved anyway. The branch principal and owner will be notified.
promo.override_reason: Add a reason (optional, kept in the audit log)
promo.override_hint: Kept in the audit log with your name.
promo.ask_admin: Ask an owner or administrator if they must all move.
promo.step_review_desc: Read it once more. You can change any answer.
promo.head_skip_one: 1 student is left out this time
promo.head_skip_other: {{count}} students are left out this time
promo.stay_title_one: 1 student cannot be moved and will stay
promo.stay_title_other: {{count}} students cannot be moved and will stay
promo.stay_body: The class has no free places for them. They stay in their current class. Go back to choose another class or ask for an exception.
promo.override_note: Placed over capacity automatically. The branch principal and owner will be notified.
promo.review_note: Nothing changes until you press the green button. Students already moved are not moved twice, even if you press it again.
promo.res_already_one: 1 student was already done before, so nothing changed for them
promo.res_already_other: {{count}} students were already done before, so nothing changed for them
promo.res_not_eligible_one: 1 student was skipped (not enrolled now, or their place in the new class is not active)
promo.res_not_eligible_other: {{count}} students were skipped (not enrolled now, or their place in the new class is not active)
promo.res_no_room_one: 1 student was not moved because the new class is full
promo.res_no_room_other: {{count}} students were not moved because the new class is full
promo.res_not_found_one: 1 student was not found in this class
promo.res_not_found_other: {{count}} students were not found in this class

ann.page_desc: News from the school for parents and staff.
ann.none_body: When the school posts news, it appears here.
ann.none_body_manage: Write the first one with the button above.
ann.remove_body: It disappears for everyone. The school keeps a record that it existed.
ann.aud_everyone_hint: Parents and staff both see it.
ann.aud_parents_hint: Only parents and guardians see it.
ann.desc_add: Three short steps: the message, who gets it and when, then a check.
ann.step_write: What do you want to say?
ann.step_write_desc: A short title and the message.
ann.why_write: Write a title and a message to continue.
ann.title_hint: A few words that tell people what it is about, for example School closed on Friday.
ann.body_hint: Write it the way you would say it to a parent.
ann.step_who_desc: Choose the people, the branch and the day.
ann.all_branches_hint: Everyone in every branch of the school.
ann.when_now_hint: People can read it right away.
ann.when_later_hint: It stays hidden until that day.
ann.step_review_desc: This is how it will look.
ann.review_note_now: When you press the green button it appears at once for the people you chose.
ann.review_note_later: It stays hidden until the day you chose, then appears for the people you chose.
ann.saved_note_scheduled: It will appear for {{audience}} on the day you chose.

svc.page_desc: Optional extras such as a transport route or an after-school class. Nothing is charged until a student is enrolled in one.

payroll.finalize_confirm_body: Every payslip becomes permanent and each employee is notified. This cannot be undone.
payroll.remove_run_body: Only a draft run can be removed this way -- all of its payslips are removed with it.
payroll.no_employee_record_title: No employee record linked to your account
payroll.no_employee_record_body: Ask HR to link your account to your employee profile before a payslip can appear here.

timetable.periods_desc: The school's own bell schedule -- Period 1, Period 2, and so on, each with its own start and end time.
timetable.period_name_hint: Optional -- e.g. "Morning Break". Leave blank to just show "Period 3".
timetable.period_type_hint: A break or lunch period can never be given a subject or teacher.
timetable.empty_periods_body: Add periods like "Period 1" before building the timetable.
timetable.remove_period_body: This only works while no timetable slot uses this period.
timetable.rooms_desc: A branch's own physical rooms, used for the timetable's room conflict check.
timetable.empty_rooms_body: Add the branch's rooms before assigning them on the timetable.
timetable.remove_room_body: This only works while no timetable slot uses this room.
timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.desc: The weekly timetable for a class, a teacher, or a room.
timetable.pick_to_view_title: Pick a class, teacher, or room
timetable.pick_to_view_body: Choose one above to see its weekly timetable.
timetable.conflict_body: You can save it anyway, with a reason -- this will be recorded and visible to anyone looking at this slot.
timetable.conflict_no_permission: This clashes with another slot. Ask someone who can override a conflict to save this instead.
timetable.remove_slot_body: The class, teacher, and room all lose this slot.
timetable.no_slots_body: Ask the office if you expect classes to be scheduled here.

period_attendance.title: Period Attendance
period_attendance.desc: Attendance for one subject's class period, separate from the daily homeroom record --
period_attendance.pick_teacher_body: Choose a teacher above to see their classes for the day.
period_attendance.no_periods_body: Nothing is on the timetable for this teacher on this day of the week.
period_attendance.take_intro: Mark who was present for this {{period}} class with {{teacher}}.

calendar.page_desc: Holidays, exams, meetings and other events for the school year.
calendar.end_hint: Leave blank for a single-day event.
calendar.branch_hint: Leave blank to show it in every branch.
calendar.none_body: Nothing has been added to the calendar yet.
calendar.none_body_manage: Add the school's first event -- a holiday, an exam period, a meeting.

medical.page_desc: Allergies, conditions, medications and emergency physician details.
medical.confidential_note: This record is only visible to staff with medical record access, and is never shown in student lists or search results.
medical.read_only: You can view this record but cannot change it.
medical.dashboard_desc: {{onFile}} of {{total}} students have medical information on file. Names only -- open a student to see or add the actual details.
medical.add_for_student: Add or view a student's medical info
medical.add_for_student_hint: Search for the student, then pick them to open their medical record.
medical.none_title: No medical records on file yet
medical.none_body: Search for a student above to add their first one.

library.catalog_desc: Books and how many copies are available.
library.no_books_body: Nothing has been added to the catalog yet.
library.no_copies_body: Add at least one physical copy of this book.
library.copy_number_hint: e.g. an accession or barcode number
library.borrower_hint: Type a student's or staff member's name
library.remove_copy_body: This only works while the copy has no loan history.
library.mark_copy_body: This takes it out of circulation until it's restored.
library.loans_desc: Books currently on loan, and any overdue ones.
library.no_active_loans_body: Every book is back on the shelf.
library.fines_off_note: Overdue fines are turned off for this school. Turn them on in Library Settings.
library.return_body_fine: This is overdue -- an estimated fine of {{amount}} will be recorded.
library.return_body_ok: This is on time -- no fine.
library.my_desc: Books you currently have, and your past loans.
library.my_none_body: Visit the library to borrow a book.
library.settings_desc: How long a book may be borrowed, and whether overdue fines apply.
library.loan_days_hint: How many days a book may be kept before it's due.
library.fines_enabled_label: Charge a fine for overdue books
library.fines_enabled_hint: Off by default -- fines are never part of tuition and never create an invoice.

discipline.confidential_note: This record is only visible to staff with discipline access, and is never shown in student lists or search results.
discipline.none_body: This student has a clean record.
discipline.attachment_hint: A photo or scanned document, if any
discipline.dashboard_desc: Every incident across the school, filterable by status.
discipline.report_incident_hint: Search for the student, then pick them to open their discipline page and write it up.

attachments.hint: Up to {{max}} photos or GIFs. No other file types.
attachments.wrong_type: Only photos (JPG/PNG) and GIFs can be attached.
attachments.unreadable: One of those files could not be read. Try again.

messages.private_note: Private between this family and whoever is currently responsible for the class (the homeroom teacher, a branch admin, or the owner). Nobody else can read it, except an auditor for oversight.
messages.class_broadcast_desc: Send one message to every parent in this class at once -- e.g. today's homework.
messages.inbox_desc: Every private conversation you can reach, most recent first.
messages.inbox_empty_body: Open a student's profile to start one.

homework.manage_desc: What you have set for your classes, draft or published.
homework.page_desc: Only what a teacher has actually published -- nothing still in progress.
homework.remove_confirm_body: This removes "{{title}}" for every student in the class. This cannot be undone.
homework.no_classes_title: No classes assigned to you yet
homework.no_classes_body: Ask your branch admin to set up your teaching assignments first.
homework.none_body: Nothing has been set for this class yet.
homework.status_hint: Draft is only visible to you. Published tells the class's families right away.
homework.attachment_hint: A worksheet or photo, if any

results.page_desc: Every published exam score, as soon as it is ready -- no need to wait for the full report card.
results.none_body: Once a teacher publishes an exam's results, they will show up here.

errors.forbidden_title: You do not have access to this page
errors.forbidden_body: Your account is not allowed to open this. If you think this is a mistake, ask your school administrator.
errors.not_found_title: This page could not be found
errors.not_found_body: The page may have moved, or the link may be old. Go back to where you were working.
errors.expired_body: This can happen after being away for a while. Please sign in again to continue.
errors.too_many_body: Please wait a short while before trying again.
errors.server_title: Something went wrong on our side
errors.server_body: This was not caused by anything you did. Please try again, or come back in a few minutes.
errors.unavailable_body: We are working on it. Please try again in a few minutes.

invoices.list_empty_year: No bills have been created for the current school year yet.
invoices.my_desc: Every bill for your children, in order, with what's paid and what's left. Print a copy any time.
invoices.my_none_body: Nothing has been billed to your children yet, or none match this filter.

complaints.none_mine: You have not submitted any complaints.
complaints.student_general: General / not specific to one child
complaints.contact_restricted_note: Contact details are restricted to staff who manage parent records.
complaints.student_restricted_note: A student — details restricted to staff who manage student records.
complaints.general_note: General — not tied to a specific child

profile.photo_desc: Shown next to your name in the header. Only you can change it.
profile.info_desc: Update your account's name and email address.
profile.resend_link: Click here to re-send the verification email.
profile.verification_sent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.
profile.password_desc: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure.
profile.deactivate_desc: Deactivating your account signs you out and stops you from using the system. Nothing you did is erased, and an administrator can reactivate the account later.
profile.deactivate_confirm_title: Are you sure you want to deactivate your account?
profile.deactivate_confirm_desc: Please enter your password to confirm you would like to deactivate your account.

academic_years.make_current_changes_body: "this year" everywhere — dashboards, the invoice list, new invoice generation, the sections offered when enrolling, and attendance/marks defaults will use {{name}} from now on.
academic_years.make_current_nochange_body: nothing already recorded. Invoices, payments, enrolments, marks and reports of every year stay exactly as they are
academic_years.make_current_keeps: ({{name}} keeps its {{invoices}} invoices and {{enrollments}} active enrolments)
academic_years.make_current_so_far: {{name}} has {{sections}} section(s), {{invoices}} invoice(s) and {{enrollments}} active enrolment(s) so far.
academic_years.reason_label: Why are you switching now? (recorded in the audit log)

idcard.status_note: (Only you see this; scanners see just the state.)
idcard.no_photo_note: If this student has no photo yet, add one from the student's edit page before printing.
idcard.batch_desc: 4 students per sheet, 2 copies of each (left and right) to cut apart. Print this sheet, then move to the next.
idcard.batch_empty_title: No students in this class yet
idcard.batch_empty_body: Nobody is actively enrolled here, so there is nothing to print.
idcard.verify_expired_text: It is no longer a current student ID. Do not accept it as one — the school office can issue a new card.
idcard.verify_suspended_text: Do not admit on this card. Please contact the school office.
idcard.verify_invalid_title: This ID card is not valid
idcard.verify_invalid_text: Do not accept it. Contact the school office if you are unsure.

books.page_desc: The books each grade needs, and their prices. Sold to a specific student from their own profile.
books.size_hint: For example "A4" or "2nd edition". Leave blank if there is only one.
books.none_title: No books in the catalog yet
books.none_body: Add the first book to start selling them to students.
books.remove_body_one: It has already been sold to {{count}} student -- their copy stays on record; this only stops it being sold to anyone else.
books.remove_body_other: It has already been sold to {{count}} students -- their copies stay on record; this only stops it being sold to anyone else.
books.all_owned: This student already has every book for their grade.
books.none_for_grade_title: No books for this grade yet
books.none_for_grade_body: Nothing has been added to the catalog for {{grade}} yet.

contact_inquiries.title: Contact Messages
contact_inquiries.desc: Messages people sent from the public Contact page on the school website.
contact_inquiries.empty_body: When someone submits the Contact page, their message will show up here.

site_content.title: Website Text
site_content.desc: Rewrite the text shown on the public school website. Anything you leave blank keeps its original wording.

site_announcements.title: Website Banner
site_announcements.desc: A short message shown at the top of the public website -- a holiday, a closure, an upcoming event.
site_announcements.message_placeholder: e.g. The school will be closed for New Year on September 11.
site_announcements.empty_body: Add one above and it will appear at the top of every public website page.
site_announcements.active_not_in_range: On, but outside its date range

gallery.title: Website Gallery
gallery.desc: Photos shown in the Campus Gallery on the public school website.
gallery.empty_body: Photos you add here will appear in the Campus Gallery on the website.
gallery.confirm_delete: Remove this photo from the website?
